item.title: Texas senate race: Talarico, Crockett in dead heat, latest poll shows
item.description: A new poll shows Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett and state Rep. James Talarico in a dead heat for the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate.The poll, released Thursday by Texas Public Opinion Research, shows 37% of likely Democratic primary voters supporting Talarico and 38% supporting Crockett.
